note: Animated React/Tailwind component library: one page per component — /button, /input, /navbar, /tabs, /stepper, /theme-toggle (each lists several animated variants; 'theme-toggle' is a switch page but not a taxonomy alias, hence the literal template, its name still tags as switch). /animations/<name> are 4 single-example pages (animated-tabs, react-animated-tabs, animated-buttons, react-animated-buttons) tagged from their names. /lp/* are landing pages and the homepage has no segments, so neither matches.
